description: This file serves as the main entry point for rendering a Playwright HTML report in a web environment. It loads a zip-encoded report, parses it, and displays it using React components, while also setting up themes and favicon links.

classes.name: ZipReport
classes.description: A class responsible for loading and managing the Playwright report stored as a zip archive, providing access to report data and entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the report zip archive, extracts entries, and parses the report JSON.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry from the zip archive and parses it as JSON.
